movie.title: Your Letter
movie.overview: After summer vacation, So-ri transfers to a new school and finds an anonymous letter in her desk drawer with an introduction to the school and a clue to finding the next letter.  "If you want to keep reading, find my second letter!" While following the clues in the letters and searching all over the school like on a treasure hunt, So-ri keeps running into a same-aged student named Dong-soon. So-ri and Dong-soon quickly become friends as they search for the letters together. As she finds one letter after another, the special connection continues, and So-ri's curiosity grows for the mysterious sender. "I want to find the last letter and thank you in person."

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: After transferring to a new school, So-ri embarks on a nostalgic treasure hunt guided by anonymous letters, discovering friendship and healing along the way.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Following a fresh start after summer vacation, So-ri transfers to a new school where she discovers a hidden note inside her desk. The letter offers a warm introduction to her new surroundings alongside a mysterious clue leading to the next message. Partnering with a classmate named Dong-soon, So-ri explores the campus to uncover each hidden note. Together, they piece together the mystery of the sender while forming a deep bond of friendship.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Transferring to a new environment after summer vacation, high schooler So-ri struggles to adjust until she finds a mysterious anonymous note stashed inside her desk drawer. The letter warmly introduces her to the school and challenges her to follow a trail of clues to uncover subsequent messages hidden throughout the campus. Intrigued by the gesture, So-ri begins exploring various corners of the school on a lighthearted treasure hunt. Along the way, she repeatedly crosses paths with Dong-soon, a fellow student who shares her curiosity. The two quickly become close friends, teaming up to solve the riddles and track down each hidden letter together. With every discovery, the mysterious sender offers comforting insights and secret highlights about the school, gradually putting So-ri at ease. As her appreciation deepens, So-ri resolves to find the final letter so she can identify the author and thank them in person. Ultimately, the quest transforms her initial isolation into a meaningful journey of connection, trust, and self-discovery.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Your Letter is an uplifting animated drama about So-ri, a transfer student attempting to navigate the unfamiliar environment of her new school following summer break. Her apprehension melts away when she stumbles upon a hidden, anonymous letter inside her desk that welcomes her and invites her on a campus-wide scavenger hunt. Joined by a helpful classmate named Dong-soon, So-ri decipher clues scattered across secret spots in the school. As the pair uncovers successive notes, they build a genuine friendship while searching for the gentle soul who orchestrated the mystery.

story_structure.climax: The search leads So-ri and Dong-soon to the final, most crucial letter, forcing So-ri to confront the true identity of the sender and the heartfelt reason why the trail was created in the first place.
story_structure.conflict: Isolated in a new environment and dealing with past burdens, So-ri faces the internal struggle of adjusting while managing her growing curiosity about the hidden sender's identity and motives.
story_structure.resolution: So-ri finds emotional healing and closure through the letters' impact, coming to appreciate her newfound friendship with Dong-soon and her place in the school community.
story_structure.introduction: So-ri transfers to a new school after summer vacation and discovers an anonymous letter hidden in her desk drawer, containing a welcome to the school and a clue leading to a second letter.
story_structure.risingAction: As So-ri follows the clues around the campus on a treasure hunt, she meets a classmate named Dong-soon. Together, they form a bond while deciphering the letters, uncovering special spots around the school, and building trust.
